title: Motion / Spatiality and Z-space

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use depth and rotation to give flat interface elements a more expressive physical presence.
strategic_value: Familiar conversation bubbles can carry Instagram’s motion character without losing their product association.
demonstration: Three chat bubbles tilt and turn in depth while their messages remain attached to the same colored surfaces.
practical_value: Compare depth changes with readability before using the treatment for longer text.

content_islands.name: Conversation stack
content_islands.spec: Arrange three bubbles vertically, alternating violet and light gray.

content_islands.name: Depth movement
content_islands.spec: Rotate and shift the bubble surfaces while keeping the message order stable.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent case-study text says motion draws inspiration from how users move through the app.
reference_purposes.Expression: The bubbles demonstrate a spatial motion treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The movement is applied to recognizable chat elements.

ingredient.name: Chat bubble depth
ingredient.role: Give a conversation an expressive spatial presence.
ingredient.application: Preserve the reading sequence as the bubbles turn in depth.
ingredient.scope: This motion demonstration only; it does not define production easing, duration or a requirement for everyday chat UI.
